decisive_items: 10.1 cm × 12.2 cm × 11.0 cm heterogeneous proximal sigmoid mass
Large fungating sigmoid mass with near-complete luminal obstruction
high-grade, poorly differentiated neoplasm with invasion through muscularis propria to serosal surface
response.rationale: R1 and R2 both identify sigmoid colon cancer, but R1 integrates imaging and endoscopic evidence. R3 (colorectal adenocarcinoma) is contradicted by negative keratin and CDX2, favoring a poorly differentiated carcinoma not typical adenocarcinoma.

rejected.why: Immunohistochemistry negative for keratin, pankeratin, CDX2, and CAM5.2 argues against colorectal adenocarcinoma.
